target: Smooth 60 fps on live vlang.io at 1708x953 and 2x
status: Average publication throughput exceeds 60 fps, but smooth 60 fps remains open: installed p95 25.01/26.48 ms and 13.8/15.7 percent deadline misses.
scope: Changed native layer publications with changed scroll position after updateLayer, over the whole first-to-last precise input period; not physical scanout.
protocol: Live HTTPS, automatic author scripting, empty private profile/cache, no proxy overrides, title readiness plus 10 second settle; 600 delta-8 inputs at nominal 120 Hz reversing every 150. Diagnostic schedules and actual timestamps are preserved per run. OS filesystem/shader caches retained.

policies.isolated_shape_passes: Default on after two matched pairs and unchanged <=3 channel bounds; VOX_GPU_CANVAS_DISABLE_ISOLATED_SHAPES=1 is control.
policies.linear_canvas_textures: Opt-in; throughput improves but tails regress, and this early cohort exposes existing shape errors.
policies.staged_uploads: Opt-in; small mixed gains/tails under falling host load.
policies.combined_upload_readback: Opt-in; throughput mixed and both maximum gaps regress.
policies.gpu_video_backdrop: Opt-in; 84.06 to 81.77 and 74.98 to 87.55 fps; live verification <=3 and focused verification <=1, older-host and failed-copy fallback preserved.

rejected_shape_pass: First split-mode experiment and first isolated attempt still differ by 7 levels. Preserving original raster extent fixes this; all rejected patches/logs remain.
limitations: The first installed screenshot check overlaps an in-flight script edit and logs a shell parsing error despite exit zero; it is rejected. The committed-script rerun pins inputs and supersedes it.
Compare only same-binary, same C-mode pairs. Host contention and live content vary.
Early linear-texture timing cannot establish optimization acceptance because the then-current shape path has errors up to 29 levels; the later safe/default isolated path fixes these.
The first grayscale test run rejects changed source pins despite its individual jobs passing; the final unchanged-source cohort passes all ten jobs.
The first sanitizer Metal fixture has mismatched private Skia TArray layouts; the corrected release-layout fixture retains compiler ASan/UBSan instrumentation and passes.
